ownershipStatement: This evidence names a legacy local commit with a non-authoritative author identity. It does not claim retroactive Integrations ownership and does not rewrite history. Four current Integrations-owned files remain adopted unchanged, while integrations/README.md is the sole Integrations-accepted documentation successor to an Infrastructure-authored source repair.

behaviorAudit.integrationsReadme: Documents the governed shared workspace lead intake contract and the default-OFF business-hours provider boundary.
businessHoursProviderAdapter: Defaults to OFF and performs zero transport calls while disabled.
Allows GET only, rejects redirects, and requires a fixed HTTPS endpoint.
Accepts strict opaque business and provider identities.
Enforces a response allowlist and complete identity-matched results.
Returns only Data normalization input records and never emits recommendation or eligibility output.
sharedWorkspaceLeadIntakeContract: Fails closed for unknown or invalid workspaces.
tests: Business-hours adapter contract and fail-closed transport behavior.
Shared workspace lead intake contract isolation and fail-closed routing.
